Torque, speed and current: the seller's sheet copied in LuwuDynamics/xgoduck_hardware docs/BOM.md, at 7.4 V, +/- 10 %; the maker's wiki lists 9 kg cm at 4.8 V and 10 at 6 V, so it may be lower. MG996R.case_screw: M3 x 16 through the lid foot and the ear, or M3 x 10 through the ear, into the printed rim (self-tapping in a 2.5 mm pilot)
MG996R.mount_source: TowerPro's MG996R page (towerpro.com.tw/product/mg996r/, read 2026-11-06): 55 g, 40.7 x 19.7 x 42.9 mm, 9.4 kg cm at 4.8 V and 11 at 6.0 V, 0.19 s/60 deg at 4.8 V (0.17 in the same page's table) and 0.15 at 6.0 V, 4.8-6.6 V, stall current 1400 mA, idle 10 mA, dead band 1 us, metal gears, JR plug, 32 cm lead. Its drawing's letters, unlabelled on the page (A 42.7, B 40.9, C 37, D 20, E 54, F 26.8 mm), are read here as: height to the spline's top, case length, case height, width, length over the ears, the ears' underside from the bottom. That reading, the ears' 2.5 mm thickness, their hole spacing (49.5 x 10 mm, 4.5 mm holes) and the shaft 10.2 mm off the case's middle are ESTIMATES from the usual drawing of this case: measure one before printing. Rated torque: none is published; a third of stall is assumed for holding (as this repo assumes for the XL330). The horn is a 25T aluminium disc horn, 20 mm across or less, with 4 M3 holes on a 13.9 mm circle and its top 6.2 mm over the case: choose one to match, or change horn_r, horn_hole_r and horn_top. No rear shaft: the far side of a fork turns on a printed hub in a 6704ZZ (spec/robot.py).

DS3218.mount_source: servodatabase.com/servo/dsservo/ds3218-mg (third party, read 2026-11-06): 60 g, 39.9 x 20.1 x 40.4 mm, 19.0 kg cm and 0.16 s/60 deg at 5.0 V, 21.5 kg cm and 0.14 s/60 deg at 6.8 V, 25T spline, dual bearings, brushed motor. At this duck's 6.0 V both are interpolated linearly: 20.4 kg cm, 0.149 s/60 deg (estimates). No maker's drawing was found: the ears (54 mm across, 2.5 mm thick, holes as the MG996R's), the case height under the spline (34.7 mm) and the shaft offset are taken from the MG996R's case, a standard size: measure one. No stall current was found from the maker: the wiring budget assumes 2.5 A. Rated torque: a third of stall, assumed.

MG90S.case_screw: M2 x 8 through the lid foot and the ear, or M2 x 6 through the ear, into the printed rim (self-tapping)
MG90S.mount_source: TowerPro's MG90S page (towerpro.com.tw/product/mg90s-3/, read 2026-11-06): 13.4 g, 22.8 x 12.2 x 28.5 mm, 1.8 kg cm at 4.8 V and 2.2 at 6.6 V, 0.10 s/60 deg at 4.8 V and 0.08 at 6.0 V, dead band 1 us, JR plug. Stall at 6.0 V interpolated linearly: 2.07 kg cm (an estimate). The page gives no drawing: the ears (32.5 mm across, 2.5 mm thick, one 2 mm hole each, 27.8 mm apart, their underside 15.9 mm up), the case height under the spline (22.7 mm), the shaft 5.9 mm off the middle and the stall current are ESTIMATES from the usual drawing of this case: measure one. The horn: a round horn trimmed to 16 mm, 4 M2 holes on an 11 mm circle, its top 6.2 mm over the case (an estimate). Armature, damping and friction: the XL330's, placeholders. Rated torque: a third of stall, assumed.
